findings.name: Flame of the First Ones
findings.topic: Uncontrolled Flame: who receives life benefit of you after last bearer drops it? Owner orders trigger but beneficiary unspecified in inspected sources.
findings.nextTest: Site novelty tracks physical Site UID since artifact entry; conjuring does not stop, actual movement then stopping does. Current stop code falls back to old controller when uncontrolled: reproduce actual drop then Displace before claiming you/your semantics.

findings.name: Bane of Aventis
findings.observed: Untargeted native Genesis changes nearby Warded Monks controller.
findings.question: Does native cannot-be-modified forbid this control change? Existing gained guard and passive King behavior differ from this generic control handler.
findings.reproduction: node --test --test-name-pattern="catalog effect Bane of Aventis: native Genesis gains" /tmp/catalog-minions-batch2-effects.mjs
findings.result: isolated assertion fails: Monks controller 0, expected 1 pending rule confirmation
findings.officialPageCacheAge: web tool reports crawled two weeks ago; not a guaranteed same-day card update check
candidates: Control is allowed because controller is not listed among minion characteristics and no primary source defines control as a status modification.
Control is blocked if a control-changing ongoing effect counts as a status modifier under cannot-be-modified.
findings.notProof: Existing King and gained-modification-guard control rejection is implementation precedent, not primary rules evidence.
